name: Daetwyler genetic-risk prediction accuracy formula
model_likelihood: Independent biallelic additive loci; continuous phenotype, with disease modeled by thresholding continuous liability
prior: No further allele-frequency or effect-distribution assumptions in the population derivation; not a Bayesian effect prior
inference_algorithm: Estimate effects by separate per-locus regressions; derive deterministic correlation accuracy from sampling variances
estimand: Correlation between true and predicted genetic values in a new sample from the same population
data_input: Individual-level phenotypic records and genotype allele counts
